ROS 2 (Robot Operating System)

Definition : ROS 2 is an open-source set of software libraries, tools, and middleware designed to build robotic applications.

Role :

  1. Middleware The software that sits between different applications or components and facilitates communication between them.

  2. Software framework It provides developers with tools, reusable components, libraries and guidelines for building software applications.

Rather than developing an entire application from scratch, developers build upon the existing structure provided by the framework.
